page.layout: One printed title page, one column, centred; a woodcut ornament below the text; imprint and date at the foot. Handwritten marks in the top left corner are not transcribed.

l.i: Qua Ecclesiae Romanae, septem Periodis distinctae, origo &
progressus, ad nostra usque tempora, pertexitur.

page.notes: Title set in red and black. The Greek phrase "κατὰ βίαυον" is as printed in the scan and may be a misprint for κατὰ βίον; the Greek letters in the scan are not fully certain. The date reads MDCLXXXIV in the printed old form (cIↄ Iↄ c LXXXIV), rendered here as printed. A woodcut ornament (a mask with foliage) appears between the title and the imprint. Handwritten "Eccles. H." in the top left corner is not transcribed.
